Introduction

Bonggeun is a South Korean singer. He is a member of the boy group T:EV and a former member of the boy group AQA and the busking group D.O.B. He made his solo debut with the digital single "Umbrella" on October 12, 2018.

In April 2025, Bonggeun and the other members of T:EV departed from Startree, the agency under which they debuted. As of now, he is not signed to any entertainment company.
